title: Uniform stratified vanishing and equidistribution on $\mathbb{G}_m^d$
summary: We prove a uniform stratified generic vanishing theorem for perverse sheaves on $\mathbb{G}_m^d$ over finite fields, with constants depending only on the dimension and on the complexity à la Sawin. As a corollary, we prove an equidistribution theorem for $\mathbb{G}_m^d$ extending Katz's theorem for $\mathbb{G}_m$. The corollary applies to sequences of perverse sheaves of bounded complexity with common tannakian monodromy group, over finite fields of varying characteristic.
